messages:
Jules: quick heads-up from usability testing on tiny viewports: the bottom floating toolbar overlaps the table's horizontal scroller and the 'Details' action. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/ux/bottom-toolbar-overlap.png :no_good:
Ravi: which phones/viewport? reproducible steps?
Jules: repro on older Androids and narrow Android emulation ~340-360px. Table with long cells shows a thin scrollbar and our bottom toolbar sits on top of the scroller and chevron, causing missed taps.
Sam: analytics also show a small increase in mobile row-action abandonment in that cohort. Good catch.
Marta: accessibility: overlapping hit targets break sequential tab focus and can confuse TalkBack/VoiceOver users. Also the toolbar's contrast at low brightness is low.
Ravi: short-term fix ideas: (1) raise toolbar at <=360px to sit above the table scroller, (2) hide the toolbar when a horizontally scrollable table is detected and the table has focus, or (3) reduce toolbar footprint to a single compact row. Which feels least invasive?
Jules: prefer (1) + small copy tweak: change action label from "Details" -> "Open details" on mobile so it's clearer the panel will overlay content. Also add a subtle top stroke to the toolbar so it appears separated from content.
Marta: if we move the toolbar, ensure it remains reachable by keyboard (add offscreen focusable element) and give it aria-label="Primary actions". Increase color contrast token by 8%.
Ravi: quick CSS I'll test locally:
```css
@media (max-width: 360px){
  .bottom-toolbar{transform: translateY(-12px); box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 var(--stroke);} 
  .console-table:focus-within .bottom-toolbar{opacity: 0.98} /* keep visible but raised */
}
```
Ravi: JS fallback: detect `.has-h-scroll` and add `.toolbar-raised` to avoid overlap when needed. I'll add a small debounce so it doesn't thrash on resize.
Sam: can we include a tiny visual affordance for the table scroller (bigger hit area) so users know it's scrollable?
Jules: yes, increase scroller height to 6px on mobile and give the chevron 12px touch padding. I'll add tokens in the doc.
Marta: accessibility checklist: keyboard focus order, TalkBack/VoiceOver pass, contrast verification, and announce changes in release notes.
Ravi: opening WIP PR: https://git.redwood/PR/4499 — includes CSS, aria updates, and the copy tweak. Will run on staging and attach screenshots.
deploy-bot: staging build 2026.04.09-31 deployed with toolbar-raise patch.
Ravi: testing now on Pixel emulator and iPhone SE; will post results here.
Jules: thanks — if staging looks good we can ship the copy change with the patch. :thumbsup:
